missing: The video is missing or the audio version has changed. Add the video again.
sourceHint: Replace the original source with an MV link or an 11-character ID.
youtubePlayer: YouTube video preview with original audio
youtubeFallback: If the embedded video is unavailable, open it on YouTube.
noFrame: There is no video frame at the current playback position.
waitingLyrics: No synced lyrics at this position.

kind.mv: Likely a music video. Preview it to check the edit.
kind.audio: This looks like an audio release. You can replace it with a music video link.
kind.lyrics: This looks like a lyric video.
kind.variant: This may be a live performance or another version. Preview it to check.
kind.unknown: There is not enough information to identify this as a music video.

permission: I have confirmed this video may be downloaded and saved locally.
candidate: Preview the video and confirm it matches this audio edit.
offsetHint: Use a positive value when the matching moment is later in the video.
removeMessage: This frees the space used by the video. The song remains playable.

error.busy: Another video task is running. Try again shortly.
error.invalid-intent: Check the video ID, quality selection, or sync offset.
error.invalid-video: This video couldn't be verified. Choose a playable H.264 MP4.
error.no-formats: This source offers no compatible H.264 MP4 formats.
error.space: There is not enough disk space, or the video exceeds 2 GB.
error.stale: The audio or library has changed. Add the video again.
error.unavailable: The video can't be opened or retrieved. Try again or choose a local file.
error.provider-disabled: Enable external sources in Settings first.
error.ffmpeg: Set up FFmpeg in Settings to verify the video.
